HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   C. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain National Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. D — Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Nairobi

8. A — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. D — Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Plan income and spending wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National Security; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Developments in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
